title: L-carnitine and Metformin in Obese PCOS Women.
brief_summary: L-carnitine and plus metformin in clomiphene-resistant obese PCOS women, reproductive and metabolic effect: a randomized clinical trial
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* pco
* obese
* ifertile

Exclusion Criteria:

* no medical disorders
* no hormonal treatment in the previous 3 months
